name: @animastor/web-generator-vbook
description: VBook agent lifecycle orchestration for Animastor web frontend. Owns the real VBook decision logic — bootstrap-vs-next-window choice, agent-status polling loop, paused/inactive/safety-cap terminal-state classification — parameterized by injected capabilities (identity getter, HTTP transport, poll state, host callbacks). No host stores, signals, api/client, navigation, or playback dependencies; SSE initiation arrives as an injected callback and finalization hands back to the host via onGenerationFinalized.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
